description: This file contains unit tests for the Http2FrameDecoder class, testing decoding of various HTTP/2 frame types, error conditions, and payload length validations.

classes.name: Http2FrameDecoderPeer
classes.description: A peer class providing access to private members of Http2FrameDecoder for testing purposes.

classes.name: Http2FrameDecoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing Http2FrameDecoder, includes methods for decoding, validation, and error simulation.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Starts decoding a frame from the buffer, updates decode counters, and handles errors.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Resumes decoding a frame, similar to StartDecoding, for incremental decoding.

methods.name: ConfirmDiscardsRemainingPayload
methods.description: Verifies that the decoder correctly discards remaining payload bytes after an error.

methods.name: PrepareDecoder
methods.description: Initializes the decoder instance with current settings.

methods.name: ResetDecodeSpeedCounters
methods.description: Resets counters tracking decoding speed paths.

methods.name: VerifyCollected
methods.description: Verifies that the collected frame parts match expected values.

methods.name: DecodePayloadAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Decodes a payload multiple times with different partitionings and validates the result.

methods.name: DecodePayloadAndValidateSeveralWays (overload)
methods.description: Decodes a payload with expected FrameParts.

methods.name: DecodePayloadExpectingError
methods.description: Decodes payload expecting a decode error.

methods.name: DecodePayloadExpectingFrameSizeError
methods.description: Decodes payload expecting a frame size error.
